tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i mchod brjod sogs las 'phros pa'i nyams len blo ldan 'jug pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i mchod brjod sogs las 'phros pa'i nyams len blo ldan 'jug pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i mchod brjod sogs las 'phros pa'i nyams len blo ldan 'jug pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shā kya mu na ye/ rgyal yum pha rol phyin pa yi/ dngos bstan sbas don rim pa gnyis/ gsal mdzad mi pham 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /'dir mngon rtog rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad sogs nas 'byung ba'i nyams len gyi rim pa cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang da lta mngon rtog rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa la phar phyin dang*/ rtsa she dbu ma 'jug pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa la dbu ma'i gzhung zhes grags kyang don la ni de gnyis ka phar phyin dang dbu ma'i gzhung yang yin no/ /de gnyis kas lta spyod gnyis ka ston yang gtso bo'i dbang du byas na ni mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel ba dang bcas pas yum gyi mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa'am spyod pa'i cha gtso bor 'grel la/ rtsa she dbu ma 'jug pa 'grel ba dang bcas pas yum gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa'am lta ba'i cha gtso bor 'grel zhing*/ de gnyis gang gi don gtso bor nyams su len yang lta spyod gnyis ka zung 'brel du nyams su len dgos pa ni 'dra'o/ /'di gnyis kyi don nyams su len tshul spyir rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar yin yang 'dir bsdus nas 'chad pa la gsum/ mngon rtogs rgyan nas 'byung ba'i nyams len dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa nas 'byung ba dang*/ 'phros don no/ /dang po la rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa ni mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lam bsgrig theg chen sgo 'byed ltar yin no/ /gang nyams su len pa ni/ lam rim chen po dang rnam bshad las/ gang thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don de nyid bsgom pas nyams su len pa dang*/ bsgoms pas nyams su len rgyu de thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs dgos so zhes bshad pa ltar te/ dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su len no/ /de yang dkon mchog dang bla ma'i yon tan sems pa dang dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba sogs dang*/

'chi ba mi rtag pa dang dkar nag gi las 'bras sems pa dang*/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag ngan song sogs kyi sdug bsngal sems pa dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems spyod pa sogs la dpyad sgom dang*/ zhi gnas sgrub pa'i skabs lta bu la 'jog sgom byed dgos so/ /mngon rtog rgyan gyis ni rigs can gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ngo bo nges pa/ grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa'i tshul rnams ston cing*/ de yang lan gcig tsam ma yin par dge ba'i dbang gis yang dang yang du zlos pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pas/ lam gyi rim pa'i go rim la 'khrugs sdebs byed dgos so/ /gzhung gis ston tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'i 'khrugs sdebs la/ thog mar rig sad par byas nas skabs dang po'i sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ skabs bzhi pa'i mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs pa zhes sogs nas 'byung ba'i tshogs lam du zhugs te/ gdams ngag nyan pa dang*/ dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas par byas nas/ bzhi ba'i dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir zhes sogs dang*/ dang po'i dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ gnyis pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni zhes sogs dang*/ gsum pa'i gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa rlom med pa zhes sogs dang*/ bzhi ba'i gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang zhes sogs dang*/ lnga pa'i rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun zhes sogs nas 'byung ba'i sbyor lam du 'jug /de nas skabs gnyis pa'i bden dang bden la bzod pa dang zhes sogs dang*/ gsum pa'i gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min zhes sogs dang*/ bzhi pa'i mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ lnga pa'i sbyin pa la sogs re re ni zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa'i mthong lam du 'jug de nas skabs gnyis pa'i de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid zhes sogs dang*/

'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs zhes sogs nas bstan pa'i sgom lam mnyam bzhag dang*/ mos pas nang gi don dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ zhes sogs dang*/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis zhes sogs nas 'byung ba'i sgom lam rjes thob dang*/ bzhi pa'i sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste/ zhes sogs dang*/ lnga pa'i 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur zhes sogs nas 'byung ba'i sgom lam du 'jug cing*/ de nas drug pa'i mthar gyis sbyor bas rim gyi bsgoms nas/ bdun pa'i sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*/ zhes sogs nas 'byung ba'i skad cig sbyor ba bskyed de/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /sogs kyi skabs bstan pa'i 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed dgos pa yin no/ /de'i tshe go sgrub sogs bzhi dang rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sogs bzhi sgom tshul de rnams dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ba gang yang bzhag ste/ 'dir rgyan gyi mchod brjod dang bstun pa'i nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus zhig brjod na/ mchod brjod kyi skabs 'dir dang por gzhi shes/ de rjes lam shes/ de nas rnam mkhyen la bstod pa de rgyan gyi gdul bya'i lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa bstod pa yin te rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas dang por mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs shing gom par byas pa'i sgo nas gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su blangs/ de rjes byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas lam gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas lam shes kyi rnam pa nyams su blangs nas/ mthar 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur ba'i lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang dang po 'dis/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam/ /de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod ces gsungs pa ltar theg dman gyi gzhi shes kyang dngos su bstan mod bstan bya'i gtso bo ni rnam bzhag gi dbang du byas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/

de yang mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i gzhi shes lta bu yin la de byang chub sems dpas gdul bya nyan rang rjes su 'dzin pa dang rang nyid 'khor ba las thar ba dang*/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs gzhom pa dang khyad par du skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong pa'i bsam pa sbyong ba'i ched du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir te/ de ltar skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i bsam pa ma sbyangs na theg chen sems bskyed mtshan nyid tshang ba mi skye zhing*/ lam shes sogs kyang mi skye bar skabs 'di'i rnam bshad las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la spyir skyes bu gsum dang thun mong ba'i lam ji lta bu yin shes dgos te/ de yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ste ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsams nas de las thar 'dod sbyong ba ni skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i blo sbyong ba yin la/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs kyi rnam pa bsams pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod spyong ba ni skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong pa'i blo sbyong ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas spyod pa spyi dang sher phyin la slob 'dod sbyong ba ni skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba yin no/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i blo sbyong tshul la rnam grangs mang du yod kyang*/ 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod kyi blo sbyong ba zhig nges par dgos shing*/ skabs 'dir ni mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa bsgoms pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba yin tai/ 'dir gzhi shes zhes pa'i sgra don ni gzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rnams shes nas nyams su len pa la bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa nyams su len pa ni gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su len tshul gtso bo yin yang*/ rgyan gyi skabs dang por dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa zhes sogs dang*/ skabs gnyis par 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi zhes sogs dang*/

bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ gsum par/ tshul rol pha rol mtha' la yin sogs dang*/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la sogs dang*/ bzhi par gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams sogs dang*/ rgyu dang lam dang sdugabasngal sogs kyis mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa spyi tsam nyams su len pa ni gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su len tshul dang*/ sems bskyed nas mi rtag sogs bcu drug bden med du sgom pa ni lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa nyams su len tshul du bshad cing*/ der ma zad byang chub sems dpa' mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa sgom pa ni nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ de dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen kyi rnam pa nyams su len tshul du'ang bshad pas bden bzhi'-i rnam pa rnams nyams su len tshul shin tu gal che'o des na der bden bzhi dang de'i rnam pa nyams su len tshul cung zad bshad na/ de yang theg chen sgo 'byed las thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang*/ rnyed na don che ba dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ ngan 'gro'i nyes dmigs sems pa dang*/ las 'bras sogs skyes bu chung ngu'i bsam pa sbyangs nas/ zhes pa nas/ thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam par bya'o/ /de la sdug bsngal la rtag pa dang*/ bde ba dang gtsang bas bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa'i gnyen por mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ bdag med pa'i rnam par bsgom par bya'o zhes 'byung ba ltar bsam pa ste/ de yang rang gzhan sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam pa la ni/ sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ sdug bsngal drug dang*/ sdug bsngal brgyad dang*/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bden gyi rang bzhin du bsam/ de nas sdug bsngal de'i rgyu gang yin snyam pa na chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang las kun 'byung bden pas bsdus pa rnams de'i rgyur ngos bzung nas spong ba la 'bad/ de nas de las grol ba'i 'gog bden ngos bzung nas thob 'dod bskyed/

de nas de thob byed kyi lam bden dngos dang des bsdus pa'i lam rnams bsten byar shes nas rang rgyud la bskyed pa'i tshul la 'bad cing rnam pa so sor nyams su len tshul ni/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'di lo zla bzhag dus rnam la ni 'bab chu ltar skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'gro zhing mi rtag la se gol tog pa'i yun tsam la yang skad cig ma re lnga tsam zhig 'da' ste/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma nas brtsams pa'i dus dang zhag dang zla ba dang lo rnams su de dang mthun par 'gyur nas mthar 'chi ba'i gnas su 'gro'o/ /'chi ba lta bu rags pa'i mi rtag pa yin la/ rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pa'i mi rtag pa ni phra ba'i mi rtag ste 'di shes pa gnas che'o/ /gzhan du na ngag nas mi rtag pa'o zhes brjod kyang snga phyi gcig 'dzin gyi rtag 'dzin dang 'bral bar mi nus so/ /sdug bsngal du bsam tshul ni sngar ltar dang*/ bsdu na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ mdor na zag bcas gyi phung po sdug bden gyi rang bzhin no snyam du bsam pa'o/ /de nas bdag ni sdug bsngal gyi phung po la brten nas btags pa tsam yin gyi/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'di las bdag don gzhan gyis stong pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po'i ngos nas kyang bdag tu grub pa'i bdag ni med do snyam du sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu med du 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyu rtag pa las skye bar 'dod pa sogs bzhi ba'i gnyen po dang*/ rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen gyi rnam pa bzhi sgom ste/ sdug bsngal de rgyu kun 'byung las skye ba dang*/ kun nas skye ba dang*/ shugs drag tu skye ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis lhan cig byed rkyen byed par bsam pa'o/ /'gog pa'i rnam bzhi ni thar ba ye med du 'dzin pa dang*/

sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ga' zhig la thar bar 'dzin pa sogs kyi gnyen por nyon mongs spangs pa'i 'gog bden de nyid sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i 'gog pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i zhi ba dang*/ de nyid phan bde'i rang bzhin yin pa dang*/ slar mi ldog pa'i rang bzhin can du bsam pa'o/ /lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi ni/ thar lam med do snyam pa dang*/ de lam ngan pa'o snyam pa sogs bzhi'i gnyen por/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de nyid thar par bgrod ba'i lam yin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal kun gyi gnyen po rig pa yin pa dang*/ gabs gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa dang*/ sdug kun slar mi skye bar bde ba'i rang bzhin du bsam pa'o/ /de ltar bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug dang*/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi rim bsgom pa gnyis ka gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bsgom pa yin no/ /de gnyis kyi nyes dmigs bsams pa'i dpyad sgom gyis blo'i 'gyur ba shugs drag bskyed pa yin gyi/ sdug kun gnyis la 'jog sgom byas pa la dgos pa med ces bshad de go ba gnad che'o/ /mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi gzhi shes ni byang chub sems dpa' mthong lam gyi bar gom pa lhur len cing*/ sgom lam nas gom pa lhur len mi byed kyang sgom par mdzad ces bshad la/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa bden med du gtso bor sgom dgos pa ni byang sems thams cad la 'dra'o/ /des na gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su len pa ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sngon par/ sems bskyed nas kyang bsgom par bya ba yin la byang sems thun mong ba gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa kun lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ci rigs sgom pa yin yang rgyas par ni/ skabs bzhi par 'byung ba ltar gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun/ lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya don gsum po thams cad kyang rnam rdzogs sbyor bas 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas so sor sgom par bshad pa ltar bya ba'o/

/de yang don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis ka'i dbang du byas pa ste/ don rnam bsgom pas de rtogs pa'i shes pa rnam kyang bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshon na/ phung po mi rtag par bsgom pa'i tshe de mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo yang bsgom pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du phung sogs bden med du sgom pa na de bden med du rtog pa'i ye shes kyang bsgom par 'gro ba'i tshul shes pa bya la/ 'on kyang bden 'dzin rtogs pa'i ye shes sgom pa'i tshe bden 'dzin sgom pa ni mi rung ngo*/ /de ltar na mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa bsgoms nas 'khor ba la yid 'byung byed pa dang*/ sems bskyed nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gtso bor byas te spyod pa la slob par byed pa'i sgo nas rnam mkhyen don du gnyer bas ni rje btsun gyi mchod brjod kyi skabs su gzhan nas mchod brjod kyi yul du smaus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la bstod phyag dngos su ma mdzad par yum mkhyen pa gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pa don yod par byas shing*/ rang gi gzhung 'di la sbyangs pa'i snying po blangs pa yin la/ nyams len 'di dag mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i yin gyi/ bdag nyid ma yin no snyam pa dang*/ lam 'di dag theg pa gsum gyi gang zag gis yin gyi bdag gi nyams len ma yin no snyam pa ni lam gol bar song ba'i rtags de/ lam rim chen mor/ gdams ngag 'di ni spyir rjes btsun byams pas mdzad pas mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gdams ngag yin la zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mngon rtog rgyan 'di ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rtsa ba lta bu yin zhing*/ 'di'i mchod brjod nas 'byung ba'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'di ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa nas 'byung ba'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang shin tu mthun pa'i phyir te byang chub lam rim 'di jo bo'i lam sgron la gzhi byas shing*/

lam sgron ni mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs pa 'phags yul gyi bstan bcos chen mo rnams la gzhi byas pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyis spyod pa gtso bor 'grel yang*/ bslab gsum cha mnyam du ston te brjod par bya ba mang yang tsam zhig smras so/ / ༈ gnyis pa dbu ma 'jug pa nas 'byung ba'i don nyams su len tshul ni/ spyir 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa gnyis ni zab don 'grel ba la dgongs pa gcig pa'i phyir/ zab don nyams su len pa'i tshul yang dgongs pa gcig go de bas mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i lam gyi rim pa ston pa'i gzhung mang yang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba las gsungs tshul rje'i 'jug pa'i ṭīkkar bkod pa ni/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'di/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan pa dang*/ /phyogs mthar gtung ba'i snying rje dang*/ /nyes la mi brten ye shes lags*/ /zhes dang*/ theg pa chen po gang zhig las/ /snying rje sngon btang spyod kun dang*/ /ye shes dri ma med bshad pa/ /sems yod su zhig de la smod/ /ces dang*/ de la byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /yon tan mdor bstan bya ba ni/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab snying rje sogs/ /sbyin pas rang don yongs btang ba/ /tshul khrims gzhan phan bya ba'o/ /bzod pa khro ba spangs pa ste/ /dkar po'i chos spel brtson 'grus so/ /bsam gtan rtse gcig nyon mongs med/ /shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs/ /snying brtse sems can thams cad la/ /snying rje ro gcig blo gros so/ /sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde/ /bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ /snying brtse bas ni don kun sgrub/ bdun po 'di dag ma lus par/ /gcig char pha rol phy-in pa yis/ /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab yul/

/'jig rten mgon po nyid thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ theg chen bar byed 'dod pas snying rje chen po spyod zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed nas spyod pa phyin drug la slob tshul phan yon dang bcas pa'i sgo nas lam bgrod pa'i nyams len bstan pas ltar ro/ /'on kyang rtsa ba shes rab dang 'jug pa 'dir lta ba gtso bor 'chad shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa yin no/ /nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams zhes sogs dang gang phyir brtse nyid zhes sogs kyi gzhung gzhan nas mchod brjod yul du dngos su smos pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la bstod phyag dngos su ma mdzad par snying rje chen po la bstod phyag dngos su mdzad pa ni/ theg chen par byed pa la snying rje chen po de thog tha bar gsum du gal che bar bstan pa sogs rgyas par ni gzhung nyid du shes par bya zhing*/ dbu ma 'jug pa 'dir rgyal sras 'phags pa'i sa bcu rgyas par 'chad pa'i sngon du tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis ston dgos shing*/ de yang mchod brjod kyi de ma thag 'byung rigs pa las mi 'byung bar rgyal sras 'phags pa'i sa gnyis nas brtsams te 'chad pa 'di ci yin zhe na/ de'i tshul ni rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las/ 'di ni mchod brjod kyi skabs nyid du bshad pas skabs 'dir ma bshad do/ /de'i dgongs pa ni/ gang bsgom pa la brten nas byang sems su 'gyur ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gsum bstan pas/ theg chen du 'jug par 'dod pas de gsum thog mar nyams su blangs dgos par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /de gsum ni sngon du nyams su len dgos par ma zad/ byang sems su gyur nas nyams su len dgos la/ gnyis la mi brtan pa'i ye shes ni spyod pa'i gtso bo yin pas des mtshon nas sbyin sogs kyi spyod pa gzhan la slob pa yang go dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ spyod pa gzhan la slob dgos pa ni 'di'i gzhung 'og ma rnams las 'byung ba'i nyams len dang*/

rin chen 'phreng ba'i lung drangs pa ltar slob dgos pa'o/ /des na mchod brjod kyi skabs su tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi lam nyams su len tshul bstan cing*/ bstan tshul yang tshogs lam dang sbyor lam nyams su len zhes pa'i ming gis dngos su ma smos kyang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gsum rang 'bras rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyur bsten pa'i sgo nas tshogs sbyor gnyis dang de dag gi nyams len gyi gtso bo gsum bstan to/ /gong du de gsum ni sngon du nyams su len dgos par ma zad/ byang sems su gyur nas nyams su len dgos la zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i chos gsum po de lam ma zhugs kho na'i rgyud kyi chos su 'jog mi nus te/ de gsum byang sems kyis nyams su len par bshad pa'i phyir khyab ste/ lam ma zhugs kho nar yod na byang sems kyi nyams len zhes pa mi 'thad pa'i phyir snyam mo/ /chos gsum gyi nang nas snying rje chen po ni chos gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa bar bstan pa yang gnad che ste/ theg chen bas ni snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos shing*/ gnyis med rtogs pa'i blos mtshon te rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag snying rje chen po dang sems bskyed gnyis kyis zin dgos pa dang*/ snying rje chen po ni thog tha bar gsum du gal che bar bstan pa'i ched yin par/ mdo las/ chos gcig lag thil du mchis na/ chos thams cad lag thil du mchis so/ /gcig po gang zhe na snying rje'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snying rje chen po ni theg chen gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin te/ snying rje chen po med na sems skyed sogs mi skye bas nyan rang ltar gzhan don rgya chen po byed pa la 'jug par mi 'dod pas 'bras bu dman zhing*/ snying rje chen po dang ma bral na snga ma las ldog ste 'byung bas sangs rgyas kyi bar theg chen gyi yon tan thams cad kyang 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/

rin chen 'phreng ba las/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'di/ bla med byang chub 'thob 'dod na/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sems can sdug bsngal thams cad la dmigs nas snying rje chen po sbyong ba la 'bad pa de dag gis/ zla bas snying rje snying rje chen po la bstod phyag mdzad pa don yod par byas zhing rang nyid kyis kyang gzhung 'di la spyangs pa'i snying po blangs pa yin la/ gzhan du na snying rje chen po zhes mang du brjod na kha phyir blta ba'i rtsod pa la 'jug pa tsam ni chus 'khyer bzhin du skom pas 'chi ba dang chos mtshungs so/ /de bzhin du lta ba'i skor la thos pa byed pa'i tshe zab mo'i don la rtogs snyam pa'i re bas 'bad dgos kyi don dang ma 'brel ba'i rtsod tshul tsam la tshig 'khris phar 'then tshun 'then byed pa ni snying po chung ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las bstan bcos las dpyad rtsod la chad pa'i phyir/ ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni de nyid bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na'ang zab mo'i gzhung la thos bsam byas pas gnas skabs log rtog rags pa log pa dang mthar log rtog thams cad spangs pa ni dgos pa'i don chen po yin te 'jug par rtog rnams log par gyur ba gang yin te/ rnam par dpyod pa'i 'bras bur mkhas pa rnams gsungs/ zhes 'byung ba ltar go dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir snying rje sbyor tshul sogs ji ltar nyams su len tshul ni/ byang chub lam rim nas 'byung ba bzhin byas na legs pa yin te/ rje'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las/ 'di rnams la nges pa bde blag tu ster ba'i thabs las dang po pas 'jug pa bde ba ni shing rta chen po'i lugs gnyis la mkhas pa'i dpal mar me mdzad kyi gdams ngag byang chub lam gyi rim par shin tu go sla ba'i 'khrid tshul bstan pa las shes par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dbu ma 'jug pa 'dir dang por nga zhes bdag zhen gyur cing*/

zhes sogs kyis sems can 'khor bar 'khor tshul zo chun gyi rgyun dang 'dra bar bsams pa la brten nas snying rje chen po sbyong tshul zhig bshad de cung zad brjod na/ zo chun gyi rgyud de thag pa sogs kyis bsdams pa de bzhin du 'khor ba'i sems can rnams las nyon gyis bsdams/ zo chun de 'jug pa po rag las pa de bzhin du rnam shes bskyod pa la rag las/ zo chun de khron pa zab mor 'phyan pa de bzhin du sems can srid rtsa nas dmyal ba'i bar du 'phyan/ zo chun de khron bar thur du 'jug sla zhing gyen du 'dren dka' ba de bzhin sems can ngan 'gror skye sla zhing bde 'gror skye dka'/ zo chun de khron par yang yang 'jug pa de bzhin du sems can bar mtshams med par 'khor/ zo chun de rtsig pa dang rdo sogs kyis bcog pa de bzhin du sems can sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung ba'i chos 'thun rnam pa drug gi tshul bsams nas byams snying rje sogs sbyong ba ste/ mdor na 'khor ba po gang 'khor na phung po la btags pa'i nga tsam 'khor/ byed pa po gang gis 'khor na ma dul ma zhi ba'i sems 'di nyid kyis 'khor/ gnas gang du na srid rtse nas mnar med kyi nang du 'khor/ ji ltar 'khor na mi 'khor ba'i skabs med par 'khor/ rgyu rkyen gang gis na las nyon gyis dbang gis 'khor/ de yang ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro gnyis las ngan 'gror skye sla zhing bde 'gror skye dka' ste/ ngan 'gror skye ba ni sa chen po'i rdul ltar grangs mang zhing bde 'gror skye ba ni thub pa'i phyag sen gyi rtse mos bzhes pa'i rdul ltar nyung ba'o/ /tshul de ltar sems can 'khor bar 'khor tshul dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams te/ de dag sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje gsum bskyed par bya ste/ snying rje gsum las sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sems can mi rtag sogs kyi rnam pa ma shar bar sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje yin la/

chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje sems can mi rtag pa dang rags pa'i bdag med ci rigs kyi rnam pa shar ba dang dmigs med kyi snying rje sems can bden med kyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi rnam pa can te/ de gsum snga ma las phyi ma khyad par du 'phags so/ /snying rje sbyong ba'i tshe thog mar rang nyid sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam pa gal che ste/ rang sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul mi shes shing ma bsams na gzhan sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul mi shes shing bsam pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na ji skad du/ rang nyid sri mtshor lhung ba ji bzhin du/ ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi go rim bzhin bsam dgos so/ /mdor na 'dir dang po snying rje sbyong ba la 'bad cing des kun bslangs te sems bskyed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab la gtso bor 'bad nas lam bgrod pa ni 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa'o/ /gsum pa 'phros don cung zad brjod na/ 'dul bya'i gzhung nas bslab pa gsum dang gtso bor tshul khrims kyi bslab pa bston te/ de yang nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te zhes nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun bslangs pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i nyam len byas nas thar bar bgrod pa'i lam gyi rim pa bstan la/ de la nges 'byung ni 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod kyi bsam pa ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa thams cad bsam pa des zin pa zhig dgos so/ /sdom pa thams cad kyi nang nas dge slong gi sdom pa ni kha na ma tho ba mtha' dag spong ba'i dbang du mdzad cing*/ tshul khrims la rnam grangs mang yang*/ gtso bo bsdu na mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims ni gal che zhing*/ de'i nang nas rtsa ba bzhi spong ba'itshul khrims ni tshul khrims gzhan rnams kyi rkang lta bu dang gtso bo yin pas 'bad dgos so/

/mngon pa mdzod las bslab pa gsum dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston cing*/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ de thob bya phyir gang dang zhes pas bden pa bzhi dang bdag med pa'i don la sogs pa chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid mngon sum shes pa dang*/ don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i shes rab rnams chos mngon pa dngos btags ci rigs su bshad cing*/ de ltar shes pa'i shes rab rnams lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dngos sam/ de'i rjes 'thun ci rigs kyis bsdus pa'o/ /mngon pa nas phung po lnga dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang khams bco brgyad kyi rnam gzhag bstan pa ltar shes na/ shes rab kyi bslab pa skyes nas de'i stobs kyis de gsum la rmongs pa'i rmongs pa chung 'bring che gsum bzlog nus par bshad pa ltar shes pa la 'bad dgos so/ /rnam 'grel sogs tshad ma'i gzhung las kyang bslab pa gsum dang*/ gtso bor shes rab kyi bslab pa bston te/ de yang mngon pa mdzod sogs nas gtso bo lung gi sgo nas 'chad la/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa sogs nas bden bzhi'i rnam pa sogs rigs pa'i sgo nas 'chad cing de las bdag med rtogs pa'i blo grol byed dngos dang gzhan rnams de'i smin byed du bshad pa'i phyir de rnam 'grel las/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pa'i sgo nas gtso bor ston pa de nyid kyang mdo nas 'byung ba'i rigs pa dang mthun par sgrub pa yin la/ rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa'i ṭīkka'i 'jug tu rgyal tshab rje'i thar lam gsal byed las/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang rjes dpag gi rten rtags la sogs pa ma bstan pa'i gsung rab mi srid pas/ gsungs rab mtha' dag las gsungs par shes pa'i mtshon byed mdzad do/ /des na ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'gog lam dang*/ de tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pas sgrub pa'i tshul khong du chud nas/

/des drang ba'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ skyabs su song nas sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub sgrub dgos pa dang*/ sgrub nus pa gnyis tshad mas legs par grub nas sems bskyed la dam bca' 'jog cing*/ rjogs pa'i byang chub de thob par byed pa la bden bzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo nyams par byas pa las 'byung bar mthong nas/ 'khor ba 'jug ldog gis bsdus pa'i bden gzhi dngos stobs kyi rigs pas phyin ci ma log par btsal te/ de'i don la yang dang yang du 'dor len phyin ci ma log pa bya'o/ /gzhung 'di'i 'go zhabs kun gyis skyabs 'gro ma 'phangs pa cung zad kyang med de/ sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i thabs ma bstan pa cung zad kyang med la/ rang rgyud la sgro 'dogs ji tsam dang bral ba de tsam gyis chos dkon mchog gi gzhi btsugs pa yin la/ nam sgro 'dogs kyi sa bon dang bral ba nas bral ba mthar thug pa'i bar chos dkon mchog yin la/ da lta sgro 'dogs mngon gyur dang bral ba la don gnyer zhugs pa nas sgro 'dogs mtha' dag dang bral ba la don gnyer zhugs pa'i blo kun skyabs 'gro'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sngar rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin de/ /zhes sogs drangs pa dang gnad gcig go /des na tshad ma'i gzhung spyi dang bye brag de las 'phros pa gzhi grub/ spyi bye brag /rgyu 'bras/ 'gal 'brel sogs kyi bsdus gzhung gi don la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas/ tshul de rnams la rmongs pa'i log rtog mngon 'gyur ba ci rigs rang rgyud kyi steng du log cing bkag pa yang chos dkon mchog gzhi gtsugs par dgos so/ /'on kyang rje rin po ches gsung gi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ shar du 'gro 'dod nub tu bgrod pa dang*/ zla 'od 'phog pas yi dwags sreg pa bzhin/ rigs gzhung nyid la brten pa'i log rtog gis/ blo mig yang nas yang du bslad pa'i mthus/

'di phyi'i dge legs kun 'joms yun ring du/ yang dag lta las phyir phyogs 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ /ches cher brtan po gsog pa mang du snang*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar ma song ba gal che zhing*/ rje'i rtog brjod las rgyas sras smon lam gadgā'i klung rnams ni/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus pa/ /gsung phyir zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar smon lam gdab cing*/ /dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar thos bsam byas pa'i dge rtsa rnams bstan pa dar bar dang rdzogs byang du bsngo bar bya'o/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung la yun ring sbyangs byas kyang*/ /nyams len mi shes zar zlos tsam brjod pa/ /de dag chu klung 'gram na gnas pa dang*/ /lhan cig skom pa'i gdung ba thob pa bzhin/ /de phyir zab cing rgya che'i gzhung dag nas/ /gsungs pa'i nyams su len tshul lde mig 'dis/ /gzhung lug chen mo rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /nyams len sgo 'phar byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i nags mdo'i sngags ram pa ngag dbang dam chos zhes bgyi bas 'di lta bu zhig bris dang kho bos bar du bsgrub par bya'o zhes bskul ba la brten nas shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas co ne'i dgon nyid du dga' bas kun nas slangs te sbyar ba'i dge bas tshul 'di par du sgrub par byed pa po dang bcas pa dbu ma 'dul mdzod tshad ma'i gzhung kun gyi don thams cad khong du chud cing nyams su blangs nas myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob par gyur cig / madgalaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mngon rtogs rgyan dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i mchod brjod sogs las 'phros pa'i nyams len lam bzang bzhugs/ -PAGE 398--PAGE 399--PAGE 380-
